absorb.title_zh: RM0008 Rev 21 中容量闪存的页、半字和两把钥匙
absorb.title_en: RM0008 Rev 21 medium-density Flash pages, half-words, and the two keys
absorb.snapshot: RM0008 Rev 21, February 2021. Printed chapter 3 is titled Memory and bus architecture. Embedded Flash memory is section 3.3.3. Table 5 prints 1 KB pages for medium-density devices. Page 0 starts at 0x08000000. The same table's page 127 starts at 0x0801FC00, which is the 128 KB end, not a 64 KB page. Table 6 prints 2 KB pages for high-density devices. That 2 KB page is void on STM32F103C8T6. This chapter points the Flash interface registers to PM0075 and does not print the key values. The claim stays: unlock FLASH_KEYR by writing 0x45670123 and then 0xCDEF89AB. Programming granularity is a half-word. An erased half-word reads back 0xFFFF. Programming can change a 1 only to a 0. This snapshot does not include an erase-time estimate and does not name an unprotected key from another family.
absorb.license: ST document terms (link and restated facts only; the manual is not redistributed)
points: Medium-density STM32F103 erases 1 KB pages. The high-density 2 KB page is void on STM32F103C8T6
Programming granularity is a half-word. An erased half-word reads 0xFFFF. Byte programming is void on this part
Unlock writes 0x45670123 and then 0xCDEF89AB. The reverse order leaves LOCK set

absorb.title_zh: RM0008 Rev 21 bxCAN 的位时间、总线关闭和过滤器
absorb.title_en: RM0008 Rev 21 bxCAN bit time, bus-off, and filters
absorb.snapshot: RM0008 Rev 21, February 2021. Printed chapter 24, Controller area network (bxCAN). Bit time is one synchronization quantum plus BS1 plus BS2. The CAN_BTR prescaler field uses the printed bits. The Bus-Off state is reached when TEC is greater than 255, so the counter value that enters bus-off is 256. Recovery requires 128 occurrences of 11 consecutive recessive bits. Other STM32F10xxx devices, including this medium-density part, have 14 filter banks. There are 2 receive FIFOs. A 32-bit filter includes STDID[10:0]. This repository places that standard identifier in FilterIdHigh shifted left by 5, which lines those 11 bits up with the high half-word. AFIO_MAPR encoding 10 maps CAN_RX to PB8 and CAN_TX to PB9. Encoding 11 maps CAN_RX to PD0 and CAN_TX to PD1. Section 9.3.3 says the port D remap is not possible on 36-, 48-, and 64-pin packages. 500 kbit/s remains prescaler 9 and 8 time quanta. This snapshot does not include a CAN base address and does not call 450 kbit/s the working point.
absorb.license: ST document terms (link and restated facts only; the manual is not redistributed)
points: At 36 MHz, prescaler 9 and 8 time quanta is 500 kbit/s. Prescaler 8 and 10 time quanta is 450 kbit/s
A transmit error counter of 256 enters bus-off. Recovery takes 128 times 11 recessive bits
14 filter banks and 2 receive FIFOs. Do not invent a CAN base address

absorb.title_en: DS5319 Rev 20 Table 5 USB and CAN pins
absorb.snapshot: DS5319 Rev 20, July 2025, Table 5 LQFP48 column. pin 31 is PA10 and pin 34 is PA13. pin 32 is PA11 and pin 33 is PA12. PA11 alternate functions include USBDM and CANRX. PA12 alternate functions include USBDP and CANTX. pin 45 is PB8 and pin 46 is PB9. PB8 remap includes I2C1_SCL and CANRX. PB9 remap includes I2C1_SDA and CANTX. Footnote 7: pins 5 and 6 on LQFP48 are OSC_IN and OSC_OUT, and PD0 and PD1 can be remapped onto them. Table 45 note 2 prints a 1.5 kilohm pull-up on USBDP (D+) to a 3.0 to 3.6 V range for USB 2.0 full-speed compliance. This snapshot does not trace the package drawing and does not assign a transceiver pinout.

absorb.snapshot: RM0008 Rev 21, February 2021. Printed chapter 23, Universal serial bus full-speed device interface (USB). On STM32F103 this block is a full-speed device, not a host. The USB clock must be 48 MHz. Table 63, vector table for other STM32F10xxx devices, which covers medium-density STM32F103, prints USB_LP_CAN_RX0. The pre-check default USB_LP_CAN1_RX0 is not the acronym in that table. Use the printed name USB_LP_CAN_RX0. RM0008 mentions an external pull-up resistor and does not print its ohms. The 48 MHz claim and the device-not-host claim do not change.

absorb.title_zh: FreeRTOS Kernel V11.3.2 的 FromISR 移位、字栈和互斥量
absorb.title_en: FreeRTOS Kernel V11.3.2 FromISR shift, word stacks, and mutexes
absorb.snapshot: FreeRTOS Kernel V11.3.2, the same release tag as freertos-1132. MIT. The Cortex-M port shifts the library priority left by (8 minus the number of priority bits) before the value used with BASEPRI. With 4 priority bits and library priority 5, the shifted value is 0x50. An interrupt with a numerically smaller priority must not call FromISR. A numerically larger task priority runs first. The xTaskCreate depth is in words. heap_4 coalesces adjacent free blocks. A mutex has priority inheritance and a binary semaphore does not. If a demo in this tag prints a library priority other than 5, record the printed formula here. This repository's EXTI priority stays 5. V11.3.2 portable/GCC/ARM_CM3/port.c does not print a library priority other than 5. This snapshot does not include the later-chapter CPU budget.
points: With 4 priority bits, 5 shifted left by 4 is 0x50. A numerically smaller interrupt must not call FromISR
A numerically larger task priority runs first. xTaskCreate depth is in words
A mutex has priority inheritance. A binary semaphore does not. heap_4 coalesces adjacent free blocks
